task.title: Accept canonical supervisor task-reassigned event-id prefixes without weakening audit verification

scope.owned_layer: The ai_status predicate that verifies deterministic supervisor task_reassigned event IDs, plus focused regression tests.
scope.not_changing: Supervisor scheduling or event production, audit payload/digest construction, actor/task/role/timestamp/chain/order/archive checks, reconciliation policy, canonical task or audit data, provider state, runtime rollout, or service lifecycle.

implementation.behavior: Keep supervisor-reassign-<sha256(payload)> valid and additionally accept supervisor-task-reassigned-<the-same-sha256(payload)>. Every other prefix or digest remains invalid.

reproduction.pre_fix_result: The verifier derived supervisor-reassign-dac420278948aad12f1f32f6804d6af63f2adace105fbaf8ed2212a26f510778 and discarded the authentic event solely because its canonical producer prefix was supervisor-task-reassigned-.
reproduction.post_fix_result: The exact archived event fixture passes _verified_done_reviewer_reassignment while preserving its original event ID and exact payload digest.

positive: supervisor-reassign- with the exact payload digest
supervisor-task-reassigned- with the exact same payload digest
negative: wrong digest under an accepted prefix
correct digest under an unlisted prefix
missing event_id, old_owner, new_owner, or parseable timestamp
valid event belonging to a different task
two valid reassignment hops with ambiguous identical timestamps
unchanged_fail_closed_checks: strict audit-source parsing and archive lineage
owner and reviewer transition fields in the digest

review.exact_head_requirement: Review and approve the exact current PR head containing this manifest. The validated implementation anchor is f2e92eb6a99d7f81b8003235443e96a658f7d062; any later non-evidence source change requires the complete verification to be rerun.
review.approval_protocol: Bind REVIEW_FILE to this manifest when approving through the governed PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT with AI_NAME=Antigravity2.
review.owner_closeout: After exact-head approval, green repository checks, and protected merge into dev, Codex must re-read the canonical row and run governed done; done is not part of this source-only implementation phase.
